summary: Stage B practice-isolation verification. Created synthetic Practice B (slug + registration_code + staff user + seeded prescription/imaging/bloodwork/message/appointment/referral/verification-patient/application rows all stamped practice_id=B), then verified cross-practice visibility across every internal queue, cross-practice single-record access, registration stamping, and default dr-aguayo no-regression. Result: 42/44 pass. One HIGH-priority leak confirmed: GET /api/internal/counters does not apply pscope — all count_documents calls run unfiltered so counters show totals across all practices. Everything else (lists for rx/imaging/bloodwork/messages/appointments/referrals/verifications/applications and single-record PATCH 404s) correctly scopes to the caller's practice. All synthetic data cleaned up in teardown.

critical.issue: Does NOT apply pscope(user). All db.*.count_documents() calls (rx, referrals, imaging, bloodwork, messages, appointments, tasks, verifications, applications) run across ALL practices for both staff/admin role and physician role (server.py lines ~2678-2694). Confirmed empirically: Practice-A admin reported rx=15, but Practice-A-only count is 11 (DB total=13 incl. one seeded Practice-B rx). Practice-B staff reported rx=15 instead of 1. Leaks aggregate counts/record existence across practices.

minor.issue: No pscope — faxed referral history is cross-practice (server.py ~3512-3516). Not tested dynamically (no seed), but visible from code review.
No pscope — recently verified/rejected patients visible cross-practice (server.py ~3720-3734).
Patient directory lookup is not practice-scoped (server.py ~3738-3753). May be intentional for shared directory, but worth confirming given isolation goals.

rca of the issue: Root cause of counters leak: when Stage B scoping was retrofitted, pscope() was added to all list endpoints but the /internal/counters endpoint — which also hits the same collections via count_documents() — was overlooked. Reproduction: 1) seed any record in a non-default practice; 2) call GET /api/internal/counters with any staff/admin/physician token; 3) observe that the returned counter includes the foreign-practice record. Mitigation: merge pscope(user) into every count_documents filter in counters(), e.g. `rx = await db.prescription_requests.count_documents({**pscope(user), 'internal_status': {'$in': RX_ACTIVE}})`.
